info.name: HashiCorp Vault KV Secrets Engine Auth Methods Secrets Engines API
HashiCorp Vault List Secrets Engine Mounts

items.docs: List all mounted secrets engines with their configuration, accessor, and options. Returns a map of mount path to engine configuration.

params.name: path
params.description: Mount path for the auth method or secrets engine. Must not contain slashes at the beginning or end.

items.docs: Mount a new secrets engine at the specified path. Supported types include aws, azure, consul, database, gcp, kv, nomad, pki, rabbitmq, ssh, totp, transit, and more.

params.name: path

items.docs: Unmount a secrets engine. All secrets stored in this engine will be revoked. This operation is irreversible.
